entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Author: K.Suresh Reddy
Bench: K.Suresh Reddy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Suresh Reddy
 Criminal Petition No.4609 of 2020
Order:

1. This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioners / Accused Nos.1 and 2 under section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against the petitioners, in F.I.R.No.494 of 2020, on the file of Nawabpet Police Station, Nellore, SPSR Nellore District.
The alleged offences against the petitioner are under sections 272, 273 and 328 of IPC and Sections 58 and 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
2. Heard Sri V.Siva Prasad Reddy, learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent / State.
agree that this matter is squarely covered by the Judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.

entities.text: Criminal Petition No.1697 of 2019 and others
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 4. In view of the fact, that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner in F.I.R.No.494 of 2020, on the file of Nawabpet Police Station, Nellore, SPSR Nellore District for the offences under sections 272, 273 and 328 of IPC and Sections 58 and 59 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this Criminal petition shall stand closed.

THE HON'BLE SRI JUSTICE K.SURESH REDDY CRIMINAL PETITION No.4609 of 2020 Dated :
